SELECT
  *
FROM
  ML.EXPLAIN_PREDICT(MODEL `mydataset.mymodel`,
    (
    SELECT
      label,
      column1,
      column2,
      column3,
      column4,
      column5
    FROM
      `mydataset.mytable`), STRUCT(3 AS top_k_features))

SELECT
  *
FROM
  ML.EXPLAIN_PREDICT(MODEL `mydataset.mymodel`,
    (
    SELECT
      label,
      column1,
      column2,
      column3,
      column4,
      column5
    FROM
      `mydataset.mytable`), STRUCT(3 AS top_k_features, 0.7 AS threshold))
